column2: Live tasks in the engine at once; a request that would make more is refused.
Funders the engine keeps, as periods, pools and recurring allotments; past it, a request is answered busy.
Live tasks in one project; a batch that would pass it is refused.
Live goals, tracked tasks, in one project; one more is refused.
Tasks ever made in one requester's tree, its root among them; an ended task gives no room back, and one more is refused.
How deep a task may be below its tree's root; a deeper one is refused.
Live direct delegates of one task; one more is refused.
Other tasks one live task may name; one more is answered busy.
Standing interests of one task; one more is answered busy.
Tasks made by one request; a larger batch is refused.
Tasks one task may depend on; more are refused.
Tasks named when waits form a circle; the rest are cut.
Resources one task may hold; more are refused.
Kinds of resource the connectors may install.
Connectors' reports on named resources kept; past it, an unreported resource counts as unavailable.
Pools whose free slots the engine keeps.
Segments in one resource's name; a longer name is refused.
Bytes in one resource's name; a longer name is refused.
Tasks waiting on one resource; one more is refused.
How long a task waits for its holds before it is held for review.
The longest grace a cancellation may give; a configured template's grace must fit it.
Inputs one task's specification may name; more are refused.
A task's specification, its words and its parameters' bytes; a longer one is refused.
Parameters of one task's specification; more are refused.
A task's result or reason; a contract may allow no more, and a longer result is refused.
Messages a run starts with or has unread, at most `tasks.inbox_messages`.
Unread messages kept for one live task; past it, a message is answered busy.
The unread messages' bytes kept for one live task, at least `tasks.message_bytes`.
One message to a task, at least `people.words` and `tasks.result_bytes`; a longer one is refused.
How long a person's task waits before its requester hears that it has stalled.
How long a proposal waits undecided at one holder before it passes up to the next.
How long an escalation waits undecided at one holder before it passes up to the next.
Resources a run's end may save its work to; a longer list fails the run's end.
Choices in one verdict contract; more are refused.
Charters the deployment may hold; more are refused.
Grants in one task's authority; more are refused.
Segments of one pattern in a task's authority; more are refused.
The patterns' bytes in one task's authority; more are refused.
Executors one task's authority may name; more are refused.
The tasks' diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Recent refusals for want of room that are kept; past it, the oldest goes.
Transient failures of a task's runs before the task is held.
The first wait after a transient failure, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.transient.max_ms`.
The longest wait after a transient failure.
Failures that need an outside fix before the task is held.
The first wait after a failure that needs an outside fix, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.permanent.max_ms`.
The longest wait after a failure that needs an outside fix.
Failures of a run itself before the task is held.
The first wait after a run's failure, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.run.max_ms`.
The longest wait after a run's failure.
Failures of the agent before the task is held.
The first wait after the agent's failure, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.agent.max_ms`.
The longest wait after the agent's failure.
Runs lost with their worker before the task is held.
The first wait after a run is lost, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.lost.max_ms`.
The longest wait after a run is lost.
Runs that end with an invalid result before the task is held.
The first wait after an invalid result, doubling with jitter up to `tasks.retries.invalid.max_ms`.
The longest wait after an invalid result.
Hosts named in a program sign-in's answer, the configured workers and the engine, at least `fleet.configured_workers` plus 1.
A worker's name in a program sign-in's answer, at least `fleet.worker_name_bytes`.
Task operations in one compound request, at least `tasks.delegates` plus 1 and `tasks.project_goals`; more are refused.
Tasks in one requested or proposed batch; a larger one is refused.
Parties the engine keeps, people and services; a new one past it is answered busy.
Entries an inbox shows; past it, its count stops and says that there are more.
Live tasks and proposals the inboxes follow, at least twice `tasks.tasks`.
Recipients one task's inbox entry may reach, at least twice `tasks.inbox_messages`, plus `authority.roles`, plus 4.
People signed in at once; past it, an expired sign-in goes, and with none a new sign-in is refused as full.
Role rosters held, each project's and the deployment's, at least the projects configured plus 1.
People holding roles in one roster; a larger roster is refused.
Owners the configuration names; more refuse the start.
Answers kept for requests asked again, with those under way, across the engine; past it, a new request is answered busy.
Recent refusals at the entrance that are kept; past it, the oldest goes.
Requests in flight at once; one more is answered busy.
Callers waiting on one request in flight, the first among them; one more is answered busy.
A party's subject, login and name together; a longer identity is refused.
The words of one ask, as an opening or a reason; longer words are refused.
One amendment of a task; a larger one is refused.
How long a person's sign-in lasts before they are signed out.
How long a request's answer is kept for the same request asked again.
The people's diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Workers the configuration names, those not connected among them; more refuse the start.
A configured worker's name, within `link.name` too; a longer one refuses the start.
Program sources one connected worker may offer, whatever its slots; a worker offering more loses its channel.
A program source's sign-in or sign-out failure, as kept; a longer one loses its worker's channel.
Workers connected at once; another worker's hello is refused.
A run's needs for its placement, its charter's and its model's.
Runs the engine hosts itself, beside its workers.
Runs one worker may host at once; a worker listing more has the rest cancelled.
Workstreams a worker is known to hold, which places a run where its work already is; past it, the oldest is forgotten.
Attempts of runs at once, those being replaced among them; a start past it is answered busy.
Credentials one run may be granted, at least `accounts.credentials` and the accounts it may use.
Runs' calls relayed at once; another is answered busy.
A run's call's name as relayed; a longer one is dropped.
A tool's name in a run's progress; a longer one is left out.
A run's turns awaiting their record, across all runs; another is answered busy.
How long a run on a lost worker is waited for, and an unclaimed run kept, before it is given up.
The fleet's diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Lost channels and refused hellos remembered, this many of each; past it, the oldest goes.
Projects with a policy at once; another is refused as full.
Roles in one project's policy; more are refused.
Requirements in the deployment's rules or one project's policy; more are refused.
Verdicts and guards one question of authority may weigh; more are refused.
Grants in one authority or one policy's role; more are refused.
Executors one authority may permit; more are refused.
Segments in a resource's name or a pattern; a longer one is refused.
One segment of a resource's name or a pattern; a longer one is refused.
Implications in the rules, a kind of grant that implies another; more are refused.
Delegates asked for in one question of authority; more are refused.
Accounts one run's question of authority may weigh; more are refused.
Resources one question of authority may write; more are refused.
Briefs gathered at once, a brief being what a run reads when it starts; another is refused.
Sections in one brief; a larger gather is refused.
The largest section a connector may give a brief; a larger one is missing from it.
A whole brief, which its sections share, each cut to fit.
Hosts one program's sign-out waits on, the workers and the engine.
LLM accounts in the deployment; another is refused.
LLM accounts one party, or the deployment, may hold; another is refused.
Program names ever issued, those retired among them; another is refused.
Sources of one account, as keys, a sign-in or a program; another is refused.
Sign-ins, kept keys and moves of accounts under way at once; another is refused.
The application's own credentials that runs may be granted, apart from LLM accounts; past it, a new one is not kept.
The first wait before a failed source is tried again, doubling up to `accounts.backoff_max_ms`.
The longest wait before a failed source is tried again.
The wait before a source that must sign in again, or lacks a scope, is tried again.
How long a move out waits for its client to write the account; past it, the move is cancelled.
How long a source may stay spent before its holder is asked to see to it.
The accounts' diagnostic facts and ended sign-ins awaiting the log; past it, one is dropped.
A credential's bytes, as a key or a sign-in's token; a longer one fails.
How long a provider's sign-in waits for its return before it fails.
Runs whose text in progress is kept to watch; another run's is not.
Watches open at once; another is answered busy.
Watches one party may hold open; another is answered busy.
Subjects one change of a watched view may name.
A run's text in progress, as kept to watch; past it, the oldest is cut and marked.
The views' diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Note scopes kept and read at once, at least `authority.grants` plus 3; past it, the oldest not needed goes.
Notes in one scope; another is refused as full.
A note's resource pattern; a longer one is refused.
A note's one-line description, and a search's words; a longer one is refused.
A note's body; a longer one is refused.
Tasks one note may name; more are refused.
Notes read from the store in one page.
Lines of the notes' index in one answer; the rest are counted.
Notes in one recalled page; the rest follow on the next.
Program sources a worker's hub keeps, apart from its run slots; a declaration past it is refused.
Runs a worker's hub hosts at once; another assignment is answered busy.
Accounts one hosted run may be granted; an assignment with more fails.
One hosted run's charter; an assignment with a larger one fails.
A run's conversation as it resumes, with what its calls kept; a larger one fails to resume.
The evidence of a settled delivery kept in a resumed conversation; more fails it.
One whole turn of a run's agent; a larger turn fails the run.
A run's declared outcome; a larger one fails the run.
The tail kept of a run's or a source's diagnostic.
Messages held for a run until it is live; another is refused as full.
Messages a run starts with, and the refused messages it keeps; a start with more fails.
One message to a run, its sender among it, and one call's input; a larger one is refused.
Calls one run may have in flight, its delivery among them; another is answered busy.
The hub's diagnostic facts awaiting the log; past it, a fact is dropped and counted.
Activity and live text queued while the link cannot take them; past it, activity is dropped and counted.
Turns of one run kept until recorded, with as many again held for its stop; past it, the run waits.
The bytes of the turns one run keeps until recorded, with as much again for its stop; past it, the run waits.
One piece of a run's live text; a larger piece is dropped.
Rows in one page of a document a client reads; the rest follow on the next page.
A text in a document a client reads; a longer one is cut and marked.
Tasks in one chips document; a larger set is refused.
Entries in a document's short lists; the rest are cut and marked.
The oldest contract version of the documents served, checked at the start alone.
The newest contract version of the documents served, checked at the start alone.
Settings proposals pending at once; another is refused.
Settings revisions held besides the newest, for running work that reads them; past it, a change is refused as full.
A charter's versions held besides the newest, for running work; past it, a change is refused as full.
Revisions the store keeps in history beyond those held; past it, the oldest goes.
Alternative models one charter may name; more are refused.
Permission mappings in one policy; more are refused.
Templates, and one project's policy's overrides of them; more are refused.
How full the store may be before new work is refused.
Numbered connectors the engine holds.
The conversation a run resumes with; past it, the oldest turns are left out.
A charter's run settings and its alternative models; a larger charter is refused.
One policy as the engine stores it; a change past it is refused.
The reason kept when a person refuses an escalation; a longer one is refused.
Parties' reads of the store under way at once; another is answered busy.
What one party's read of the store brings; its page is cut to fit.
Runs' calls whose answers are kept for replay, with those in flight; past it, a new call is unavailable.
One call's input and answer, as kept; a larger one is refused.
Parts of one section of a brief that the engine writes; the rest are cut.
The tail of an earlier conversation in a fresh run's brief; cut to fit.
The task's section of a brief; cut to fit.
The dependencies' results in a brief; cut to fit.
The earlier attempts' section of a brief; cut or left out to fit.
The plan's section of a brief, its delegates; cut or left out to fit.
The notes' index in a brief; cut to fit.
The piece in which a worker's channel is read; it bounds no whole.
A worker's name as its channel carries it; a longer one is refused.
A worker's secret, as its file holds it; a longer one is refused.
Workers the engine's channel knows by name; more refuse the start.
Channels the engine may be opening beside its connected workers; another is turned away.
How long a worker's channel may take to open; past it, the channel closes.
How long the engine waits for a worker's hello once its channel opens; past it, the channel closes.
The wait between two pings on a worker's channel.
How long a worker's channel may stay silent before it is lost.
How long a worker's channel may fail to send before it is lost.
The first wait before a worker dials its engine again, doubling up to `link.ceiling_ms`.
The longest wait before a worker dials its engine again.
How long a worker must stay connected before its wait to dial again starts afresh.
The wait before a worker sends again a turn the engine was too busy to take.
Room on a worker's channel kept for its diagnostic facts.
Sign-in codes the engine's own sign-in provider holds at once; another sign-in is answered busy.
Access tokens the engine's own sign-in provider holds at once, its pending codes counted; another is answered busy.
